modules.title: Introduction to Jimla (Sentences)
modules.html:
Hausa sentence types, structure and punctuation. This section covers introduction to jimla (sentences).

Key points

  • Menene 'Gishirin jimla' — Particles/Conjunctions.

Worked examples

Q: Menene 'Gishirin jimla'?
A: Particles/Conjunctions — Particles and small functional words like 'da', 'ko', 'ma' are often called the 'salt' (gishiri) of a sentence.

Q: Wane littafi ne Dr. Abubakar Imam ya rubuta?
A: Magana Jari Ce — Dr. Abubakar Imam is the renowned author of the Hausa classic 'Magana Jari Ce'.

More key points

  • Menene 'Gishirin jimla' — Particles/Conjunctions.

examples.q: Wane littafi ne Dr. Abubakar Imam ya rubuta?

quiz.q: Menene 'Gishirin jimla'?
quiz.solution: Particles and small functional words like 'da', 'ko', 'ma' are often called the 'salt' (gishiri) of a sentence.

quiz.q: Wane littafi ne Dr. Abubakar Imam ya rubuta?
quiz.solution: Dr. Abubakar Imam is the renowned author of the Hausa classic 'Magana Jari Ce'.

quiz.q: Wanene babban jagoran sarautar gargajiya a masarautar Kano?
quiz.solution: Traditional rulers in Northern Nigeria, specifically Kano, hold the title of 'Emir' (Sarki).

quiz.q: Idan mace ta haifi 'Tagwaye', mene ne ma'anar hakan?
quiz.solution: 'Tagwaye' is the Hausa word for twins.

quiz.q: Menene sunan mahaifin mutum a Hausa?
quiz.solution: 'Baba' or 'Uba' is the term for father.

quiz.q: Menene ma'anar 'Sadarwa'?
quiz.solution: 'Sadarwa' is the Hausa term for Communication.

quiz.q: Wanne ne sunan dabba mai wuya mai tsayi?
quiz.solution: 'Rakumin Dawa' is the Hausa name for a Giraffe, characterized by its long neck.

quiz.q: Menene 'Surutu'?
quiz.solution: 'Surutu' refers to excessive talking or noise.

quiz.q: Cika wannan: 'Ina _____ Hausa.'
quiz.solution: To understand or speak a language, the word 'ji' (hear/feel/understand) is used. 'Ina jin Hausa'.

quiz.q: A tsarin sarautar Hausawa, wanene yake biye da Sarki?
quiz.solution: The Waziri is the Prime Minister or the king's most senior advisor.

quiz.q: Wanne ne sunan azuzuwan Hausa (standard)?
quiz.solution: Standard Hausa used in writing and formal settings is called 'Daidaitacciyar Hausa'.

quiz.q: Wanne harafi ne 'H'?
quiz.solution: In phonology, 'H' is a voiceless glottal fricative (bakari marar sauti).

quiz.q: Bayajidda ya fito daga:
'Ina kwana' means:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Good morning.

quiz.q: Menene 'Meat'?
Menene 'Friend'?
Me ake nufi da 'Sunauni'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Adverb (Modification of verb).

quiz.q: Menene 'Sana'a'?
Wanne ne 'Alkalami'?
A tsarin lissafin Hausa, nawa ne 'Goma sha biyar'?
Mene ne 'Kunge'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Wasar yara.

quiz.q: Mene ne 'Habaici'?
options: Magana ta fakaici don cin mutunci
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Magana ta fakaici don cin mutunci.

quiz.q: Babban abincin Hausawa shi ne:
Kalmar 'Zo' tana nufin:
Mene ne sunan 'Eye' da Hausa?
Wanne ne lambar 'Ten' da Hausa?
'Zo' means:
Hausa alphabet:
Menene 'Four'?
